title: First-order power series comparison for a complete local algebra over a field
statement: Let k be a field and A a complete Noetherian local k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], with maximal ideal m and residue field K. Let d be the minimal number of generators of m, let T=K[[X_1,...,X_d]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and put N=(X_1,...,X_d). There is a surjective ring map g:A -> T/N^2 whose inverse image of the image of N is exactly m. No formal smoothness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 07EI, construction of f_1; coefficient field from Algebra Tag 032A

proof.text: Let p be the characteristic of k. The composite k -> A -> K is injective since k is a field and K is nontrivial, so K also has characteristic p. Obtain a coefficient subring Lambda with residue isomorphism and maximal ideal generated by p. But p=0 in A by the k-algebra map, hence p=0 in Lambda. Its maximal ideal J is therefore zero. The inclusion Lambda -> A descends to Lambda/J; compose this map with the inverse of its residue isomorphism to obtain s:K -> A splitting reduction. This is the proved private helper exists_coefficient_field_section.
Apply the split local first-order coordinate theorem to s. This gives eA:A/m^2 -> K plus K^d whose first coordinate is reduction.
Apply the power-series coordinate theorem to Fin d and K. This gives eT:T/N^2 -> K plus K^d, with the image of N characterized by zero first coordinate.

Define g=eT^(-1) composed with eA composed with the quotient A -> A/m^2. All three maps are surjective. For a in A, g(a) is in the image of N exactly when the first coordinate of eT(g(a)), hence of eA(a mod m^2), is zero. This coordinate is residue(a), whose vanishing is equivalent to a in m. Ideal extensionality proves the required preimage equality. All arguments include d=0.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_firstOrder_powerSeries_comparison (k : Type u) (A : Type v)
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A] :
    let T := MvPowerSeries (Fin (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).spanFinrank)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
    let N : Ideal T := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦ (MvPowerSeries.X i : T)))
    ∃ g : A →+* T ⧸ N ^ 2,
      Function.Surjective g ∧
      (N.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (N ^ 2))).comap g =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
